artifactKind: Scoped independent visual receipt of actual decoded encoded MP4 frames

scope.method: All 18 contact sheets were displayed via view_image and every cell inspected; four selected actual JPEGs were additionally displayed at full-frame size. Frame/source/index/sheet hashes and actual MP4 hash were independently recalculated and matched.
scope.sourceDistinction: These are actual decoded final-v3 MP4 JPEGs, not the earlier C20 Blender/compositor PNG contact sheets.

observations.note: The lever close-up crops the non-active left body intentionally; active +/- lever and number labels remain visible, and captions do not obscure the active lever. This is not classified as whole-model clipping without treating the intended close-up as a whole-model shot.
Shishiodoshi analogy tag, water filling, tilt/spill, and return are readable. Transition to the machine retains visible digit labels.
09999 carry sequence and completed 10000 are readable; raised yellow arms and the right hand do not obscure the completed display.
Domino/face-cutaway/prototype sequence remains legible. Where the physical score board and 2D HUD are both visible, their 0–2 values agree.
The previously reported obsolete 0–1 HUD fade is absent in the encoded MP4. Physical board remains 0–2; frame 9227 was also inspected enlarged.

Enlarged 312.433/312.467 s frames show the blue full-face conclusion cutaway without an early competing HUD. At 313.733 s the fading face reveals a 1–2 physical board, and 314 s shows the 1–2 HUD; no conflicting score values were observed. This is image timing evidence, not an independent ear-verified voice-end timestamp.
The repeated-addition diagram shows 7×3 = 7+7+7 and displayed 00021; explanatory cards and subtitles do not obscure the digit row.
The five-wheel challenge displays 00999, 999+1 and the unanswered arm-drop question. The prompt cards, digits and hand remain readable; no premature numerical answer is shown.

Closing desk shot retains machine, paper, pen and candle without apparent principal clipping; captions are legible. Background book at lower left is intentionally partial and not treated as the active principal.

unverified: No audio was listened to in this scoped review; earsVerified is false.
Pages 001–036 are assigned to other reviewers and are not claimed here.
No claim is made that every 30 fps frame was visually inspected.
Eight-wheel sequence lies outside pages 037–054; this receipt does not independently certify it.
Original quality gate results, sparse/7b numerical NG and geometry supplement are not overridden by this scoped visual review.
No source/helper/cache/MP4 was edited, no encode or GPU job was launched.
scopeConclusion: No new actionable crop/overlap/subtitle/face/score defect observed in the assigned 154 cells plus three unique enlarged boundary frames; final acceptance remains with root and the combined checks.
